name: order_api
description: Call the Order API. create_order posts a new order, get_order fetches one order by id, and list_orders returns every order. Requests go through the Kong route /api/orders.

action.description: Which Order API operation to call.

item.description: Item name. Required when action is create_order.

quantity.description: Quantity greater than 0. Required when action is create_order.

id.description: Order id. Required when action is get_order.
